tasks.dev: deno task dev:back & deno task dev:front
tasks.check: deno task --cwd back check && deno task --cwd front check
tasks.lint: deno task --cwd back lint && deno task --cwd front lint
tasks.fmt: deno task --cwd back fmt && deno task --cwd front fmt
tasks.fmt:check: deno task --cwd back fmt:check && deno task --cwd front fmt:check
tasks.test: deno task --cwd back test && deno task --cwd front test
tasks.coverage: deno task --cwd back coverage && deno task --cwd front coverage
tasks.ci: deno task test:scripts && deno task --cwd back ci && deno task --cwd front ci && deno task lint:docs
tasks.ci:rapido: deno task --cwd back fmt:check && deno task --cwd back lint && deno task --cwd front fmt:check && deno task --cwd front lint
